name: a2_dungeon_gateway_north
notes: Author's WorldEditor selection (WE_OBJECTS_V1 paste, 2 records, 2/2 found on map_a2 at (282, 1459); the same pair stands on map_n_threeway, trent and trent02). FRONTS NORTH (facing 0): the road arrives from the north and ends in it. A rune-carved stone arch set in its own boulder, with a crystal pillar either side -- all ONE model (warpgate01, CRC 2233504330 -- NOT the octagonal arch 929619867, which shares the name) -- sunk 25 cm, with the red portal effect (warpgate03) 4 m in front of it sunk 95 cm. It is a TERRAIN FIT: the arch stands in a notch at the foot of a rock face at the dead end of a road, 75 m from the map edge, so the rock closes round its back and sides. Put it where a road meets a cliff, pad_radius_m 6 so the pad does not level the face. The source adds a carved slab (Pagoda3) and two trees beside it, which the author left out. rotate_deg = (0 - B) mod 360.
